_comment: PUBLIC SETTINGS ONLY. Every URL here is a same-origin path on the OneJarc server, which signs users in with Microsoft Entra ID and keeps the catalog in MongoDB. loginWebhookUrl is still required by the config parser but is unused (sign-in is /auth/login). Never put credentials here.

tools._comment: Unused: the catalog uses getToolsWebhookUrl and the /api/tools/<action> paths in site/assets/*-tool.js.

categories._comment: NOT IMPLEMENTED: shared category loading and admin edits.

favorites._comment: NOT IMPLEMENTED: each authenticated user's saved favorites across devices.

preferences._comment: NOT IMPLEMENTED: each authenticated user's saved settings. Current settings remain browser-local.

notifications._comment: NOT IMPLEMENTED: load notifications and save read state for the authenticated user.

status._comment: NOT IMPLEMENTED: live tool health and maintenance information. Leave writeUrl blank unless a future service needs it.
